subject.title: [Feature]: Owner Takeover / Human Handoff for DM Auto-Reply

question: Should owner/human handoff be added as an opt-in WhatsApp plugin feature first, or designed as a shared channel contract across WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but the requested fix adds new config, per-thread state, and resume semantics that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product surface.

options.title: Opt-in WhatsApp plugin handoff first
options.body: Add a narrow WhatsApp-owned owner handoff config and per-DM pause/resume behavior with no default behavior change and live WhatsApp proof.

options.title: Shared channel contract
options.body: Design a common channel-level human takeover API before implementation so Telegram and Discord get the same semantics at the cost of larger surface area.

options.title: Defer to manual controls/instructions
options.body: Keep the issue open or close as not planned if maintainers do not want another auto-reply policy surface beyond existing manual pause and instruction workarounds.

recommendation.title: Opt-in WhatsApp plugin handoff first
recommendation.body: Add a narrow WhatsApp-owned owner handoff config and per-DM pause/resume behavior with no default behavior change and live WhatsApp proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent high-confidence owner signal for WhatsApp inbound admission and auto-reply runtime paths where the feature would be integrated.
